requirement.description: The Flask route decorator wrapper incorrectly attempts to register the same endpoint function multiple times, causing a "View function mapping is overwriting an existing endpoint function: hook" error. The current implementation tries to register the hook function instead of the original function with Flask's route decorator.
requirement.contract: The Flask route decorator wrapper must correctly delegate to Flask's original route decorator by passing the original function to Flask, while our hook should wrap the function that Flask actually registers. The wrapper should not interfere with Flask's internal endpoint registration process.

requirement.description: The Flask errorhandler decorator wrapper has the same fundamental issue as the route decorator - it doesn't properly delegate to Flask's original decorator without interfering with Flask's endpoint registration.
requirement.contract: The Flask errorhandler decorator wrapper must correctly delegate to Flask's original errorhandler decorator by passing the original function to Flask, while our hook should wrap the function that Flask actually registers. The wrapper should not interfere with Flask's internal endpoint registration process.
